ClinicalDocument.title: SYNTHETIC RECORD, NOT A REAL MEDICAL RECORD — Progress Note 4 — Focused Visit (Follow-up) — Booker T. Washington — True-date frame: synthetic events are moved into the patient's historical lifetime. Codes, instruments, and treatments remain modern and are anachronistic.

text.paragraph: Mr. Washington returns four weeks after chlorthalidone was added. His home readings run in the 120s and low 130s over 70s and 80s. He has had no headaches for six weeks, and his concentration is a little better. He has had no lightheadedness on standing, muscle cramps, or joint pain, and he takes all five medicines every morning from a weekly organizer. He still gets up once or twice a night to urinate. [S]
